description: The Odisha Higher Education Department will replace the Good Citizenship course with an ‘AI for All’ value-added course for students enrolled in the Apprenticeship Embedded Degree Programme (AEDP) from the second semester of the 2026-27 academic session.Director of Higher Education Kaliprasanna Mohapatra has directed higher education institutions to implement the revised course during the current academic session. The initiative aims to equip students with basic knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) and practical skills relevant to workplace requirements before they begin their industry apprenticeship.The new course will follow the structure of the ‘AI for All’ skill enhancement course already offered to students outside the AEDP. Institutions have been asked to make the necessary arrangements for its rollout from the second semester, replacing the existing Good Citizenship course in the programme.Odisha Expands Apprenticeship-Embedded Degree ProgrammeThe curriculum change comes as Odisha expands the reach of its AEDP across higher education institutions. The programme has grown from 31 institutions offering two subjects in the previous academic year to 81 institutions offering 11 subjects in 2026-27.Under the AEDP structure, students undertake two years of academic learning followed by one year of apprenticeship training, allowing them to gain industry exposure alongside their degree education.NASSCOM Partnership To Strengthen AI SkillsThe state higher education department has also partnered with NASSCOM to provide online AI training to more than one lakh students and faculty members. The collaboration aims to strengthen technology-related skills across higher education institutions.The introduction of the ‘AI for All’ course for AEDP students is part of the state's broader effort to integrate AI learning into degree programmes and improve students' preparedness for industry requirements.
